title: Sleep, Upper Airway and Dental Occlusion in Children With Large Overjet

sections.abstract: This project examines sleep (e.g. prevalence of obstructive sleep apnea(OSA)), dimension of upper airway, jaw function, well-being and quality of life in children with large overjet compared to a control group. In addition, the effect of treatment with a mandibular advancement device (MAD) on sleep, upper airway and jaw function are examined, and how these factors affect the children's well-being and quality of life.
